mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports antibiofilm phenotypic activity for 1018-derived and QSAR-derived peptides against S. aureus MRSA SAP0017 biofilms, with 3002 reported as more potent than 1018.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is phenotypic biofilm inhibition/eradication evidence, not a resolved molecular mechanism or direct target claim.
